sentences.text: Sadek Ali @ Sadikul Islam vs Unknown on 22 March, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
22.03.2023

Serial no. 27 [Dd] (Anticipatory bail) (Rejected) Crm (A) 1177 of 2023 In re : An
Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection
with Chanchal Police Station Case No. 1301 of 2022 dated 02.11.2022 under Sections
498A/323/325/376/511/308/34 of Ipc (G.R. no. 3033 of 2022).
-And-
In the matter of : Sadek Ali @ Sadikul Islam ... ...Petitioner Ms. Minoti Gomes, Mr. Musharraf Alam
Sk.
Ms. Susmita Ghorai, Advocates ... ...
For the Petitioner Mr. Sujoy Sarkar, Mr. Rahul Chachan,

... For the De facto complainant Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, ld. Pp Mr. Imran Ali, Ms.
Debjani Sahu, Advocates .. ...
For the State Petitioner prays for anticipatory bail.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the first information report was lodged 19 days after the incident.
Learned advocate for the State draws the attention of the Court to the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Criminal Procedure Code as also her medical examination report.
Learned advocate for the de facto complainant submits that the petitioner is guilty of the offences alleged.
The statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Criminal Procedure Code implicates the petitioner in an incident of rape.
Her statement apparently stands corroborated by the medical examination report.

Considering the gravity of the offence and the involvement of the petitioner in the incident as transpiring from the materials in the case diary, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
Sadek Ali @ Sadikul Islam vs Unknown
